title: Benefit Interpretation — How Vision Plans Contact Lenses Are Settled Against Glasses and the Certified Reason
content:
**Benefit interpretation, Vision Plans contact-lens orders**

How the contact-lens line of a contact-lens order is settled depends on the person's glasses and on the reason the provider certified. The first branch that holds applies.

**Branch 1 — glasses hold the period's benefit.** This branch applies in either of two situations:
- any spectacle-lens or frame service of the same person counts in the benefit period of the order; or
- the order's own claim carries a spectacle-lens or frame line that carries no remark yet or stands denied as not eligible, the eyeglasses order of the same claim being settled first.

The glasses then hold the period's materials benefit. The contact lenses are bought outside the benefit with the remark for contacts in lieu of glasses: at the retail charge less the outside-benefit discount rate at a participating location, and at the whole receipt out of network.

*Counting rule:* a spectacle-lens or frame service of the same person counts in the order's benefit period when it is the latest service of its kind (spectacle lenses and frames each being a kind of their own) of the enrollment whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid, and its date of service falls in the same benefit period as the order, whatever its order against it. When that latest one is the only such service on its date and has been reversed, there is taken to be none of that kind and no earlier one is looked at; of several on that date, a reversal of one leaves that date standing. A benefit period is the twelve-month period that starts each year on the enrollment's benefit-period reset day, and a latest service dated in another benefit period counts nothing.

**Branch 2 — certified medically necessary.** Otherwise, when the provider certified the contact lenses as medically necessary (the contact-lens reason on the line), they are covered in full after the materials copay at a participating location, and reimbursed up to the plan's out-of-network medically necessary contact-lens amount out of network.

**Branch 3 — elective.** Otherwise, the contact lenses take the contacts allowance as elective contact lenses. At a participating location the member pays the materials copay plus the part above the plan's elective allowance; out of network they are reimbursed up to the out-of-network elective amount.

| Glasses counting in the period, or open glasses lines on the same claim | Certified medically necessary | Participating location | Out of network |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Either | Retail charge less the outside-benefit discount rate | Whole receipt |
| No | Yes | Materials copay only | Receipt less the lesser of the receipt and the medically necessary amount |
| No | No | Materials copay plus the part above the elective allowance | Receipt less the lesser of the receipt and the elective amount |

*Hypothetical cases.* A person whose glasses lenses were paid in the same benefit period buys contact lenses: Branch 1. A person whose only glasses were paid in the previous benefit period, with lenses certified for keratoconus: Branch 2.
